decisions.reason: Changing the arrangement from five-plus-three to two rows of four does not change the already confirmed eight-badge set, achievement rules, icons, milestones, storage, or effects.
The dashboard badge-grid arrangement does not change which referral or reward attributes appear in NFT metadata.
The badge layout change does not alter which NFT assets, badges, referral codes, or ticket states transfer on resale.
The badge-grid request is independent of book-cover rendering, ebook metadata links, and View Book controls.
The requested four-by-four dashboard badge arrangement does not change landing-page hero content or layout.
The badge-grid arrangement does not require any change to the FAQ's badge explanation or other informational copy.
Badge placement on the dashboard does not change the rule for displaying only successfully minted NFTs.
The dashboard badge-grid layout does not change the About page's descriptive content or its general mention of badges and leaderboards.
The badge-grid layout does not change the Mission page's general gamification copy or any other mission content.
The dashboard badge arrangement is unrelated to the landing-page book cover's location, size, overlap, or visibility rules.
Changing badge placement does not affect how the dashboard counts successfully minted NFTs.
The badge-grid layout does not affect ebook reader mode, technology, or navigation entry points.
